name: context-guru
description: Installs a local context-guru proxy, routes this project's Claude Code sessions through it, and reports what it saved. Reversible: /context-guru:uninstall removes the one settings key it adds and stops the proxy.

port.title: Proxy port
port.description: Local port the proxy listens on. The port must be FIXED rather than negotiated: the ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL written into your settings and the session hook that starts the proxy have to agree, and a URL cannot be renegotiated after it is written. Default 8787 — deliberately not 4000, which collides with litellm.

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: Compaction PIPELINE - what happens to the request body. `off` (the default) is passthrough: no components run at all, so your requests are forwarded byte-for-byte. Nothing is dropped, no markers are written, no tool is injected and no model is called - not as a promise, but because there is nothing in the pipeline to do any of it. `cache` is the lightest opt-in: still nothing dropped. `house`, `codesmart`, and `housellm` add real offloaders, and `housellm` also spends on its own - each a deliberate step into context editing, not the default. This is a DIFFERENT option from `cache_strategy` below, which decides whether idle keep-alive pings are sent and DOES make model calls by default, regardless of what this option is set to.

cache_strategy.title: Cache strategy
cache_strategy.description: Which cache mechanism runs, by NAME, so switching back is one word rather than four tuning numbers. `5-min-ping` (the default) pings just under the provider's 5-minute cache TTL - at most 2 per idle span, only on prefixes over 20k tokens, capped at $0.25 a ping - and it SPENDS YOUR OWN CREDENTIAL while nobody is at the keyboard, which is the whole point: it is what keeps the cache warm across a gap, and it is the one component of this plugin aimed at a cost that was actually measured: idle cache misses were 3.7% of requests and 23.6% of ALL spend over the measured window, at an 8.5x penalty per request. Whether it nets positive on YOUR traffic is a different question, answered by keepalive_net_usd (in /stats' savings block, no dashboard needed) rather than assumed - a negative net is possible, and the picker says so and offers `none`. `none` turns it off: no pings, no spend. `1-hour-head` asks for the 1-hour tier on the tools/system breakpoints instead, and only on requests with a >=50k -token prefix - under that it does nothing at all. Measured GRANTED on Haiku 4.5 and silently DOWNGRADED on Sonnet 5, so on Opus/Sonnet expect $0 until Usage.CacheWrite1h says otherwise; both of those measurements were on prefixes under the 50k gate. `/context-guru:cache-strategy-picker` names each one and what it costs.

idle_exit.title: Idle exit
idle_exit.description: Exit the proxy after this long with no requests and no keep-alive ping pending, so nothing is left running on your machine. Must be at least 2x the store's entry lifetime (~5h34m at the default), because exiting clears in-memory cache state.

upstream.title: Upstream base URL
upstream.description: Forward to this Anthropic-compatible base URL instead of api.anthropic.com. Set it when something else is already the gateway — a hosted agent pod, a corporate gateway — so the proxy CHAINS behind it rather than replacing it. That gateway keeps holding the credential and, on at least one pod, rewriting model names: bypassing it sends model ids the real API has never heard of and every request fails. Empty means go straight to Anthropic.
